article.title: Two PDP reps join APC in Abakaliki
article.text: Two members of the House of Representatives, Hon. Chidi Ogbonna-Ike (Ebonyi Demo Constituency 2) and Hon. Mercy Odey-Agbor (Cross River Demo Constituency 1), on Monday left the Peoples Democratic Party and joined the All Progressives Congress at a rally in Abakaliki. Both collected APC membership cards from the national chairman.
